conclusion: Bundled web pages translate through resources/web/include/i18n.js, data-i18n keys, and the host gettext dictionary ORCA_UI_STRINGS. Missing legacy text.js references or redundant declarations can abort initialization before RequestProfile. Printer pages 21 and 24 load guide/21/common.js and initialize its globals once; material pages 22 and 23 use guide/22/common.js without overriding its selection functions. Selection submits full preset names from filalist through save_userguide_filaments. Simplified and Traditional Chinese catalogs must cover the host keys used by static markup and dynamic controls. Loading-page completion waits for both native profile readiness and the userguide_loading_page_ready message emitted by guide/0/load.js; the existing slow-computer fallback remains.
scope: InlongSlicer bundled web wizard and preset dialogs

All five current web contract tests and all 23 locale msgfmt checks pass after the catalog merge. The earlier 34 wizard-browser scenarios were not rerun in this sync; color-picker browser coverage is a different check. Reviewed source snapshots support the initialization contract, not a claim of a fresh manual native wizard session. File hashes bind the reviewed merge-worktree bytes; the pre-merge HEAD is a checkout anchor, not a claim that uncommitted bytes already belong to it.
